# Verification: proving the engineering claims

Traceability is incomplete if requirements terminate at design. This chapter models verification as first-class engineering objects and connects successful tests to explicit evidence.

The test cases below correspond to real classes of regression checks in the repository. The evidence objects identify the durable artifact or test surface that demonstrates the result.

## Test cases

::: {.need #TC-001 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="snapshot;graph;semantics" evidenced-by="EVD-001"}
## Canonical graph and snapshot regression

Analyze a representative project twice and verify stable objects, relations, semantic metadata, and canonical snapshot output.
:::

::: {.need #TC-002 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="quarto;render;accessibility" evidenced-by="EVD-002"}
## Quarto progressive-render regression

Render the example and verify that static graph output, accessible traceability, and progressive HTML assets are produced from the same engineering projection.
:::

::: {.need #TC-003 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="governance;rules;gates" evidenced-by="EVD-003"}
## Strict governance regression

Run the configured rule engine and quality gates against a conforming project and verify a successful deterministic verdict.
:::

::: {.need #TC-004 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="adr;decision;governance" evidenced-by="EVD-004"}
## Architecture-decision governance regression

Verify accepted-decision driver, scope, confirmation, lineage, lifecycle, and revisit-date rules.
:::

::: {.need #TC-005 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="localization;i18n;parity" evidenced-by="EVD-005"}
## Localized-source semantic-parity regression

Compare canonical and pt-BR declaration batches and reject any change to IDs, types, statuses, attributes, or relations.
:::

::: {.need #TC-006 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="graph;schema;security;limits" evidenced-by="EVD-006"}
## Public graph contract and safety regression

Validate public graph JSON against its schema, enforce graph budgets, and verify that unsafe source paths are not published as provenance.
:::

::: {.need #TC-007 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="parser;qmd;authoring" evidenced-by="EVD-007"}
## QMD declaration parsing regression

Parse representative `.need` blocks and verify stable identity, attributes, relations, rationale, and source locations.
:::

::: {.need #TC-008 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="relations;catalog;semantics" evidenced-by="EVD-008"}
## Relation-catalog semantic regression

Verify canonical relation names, semantic families, endpoint roles, impact direction, and traversal direction.
:::

::: {.need #TC-009 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="query;graph;views" evidenced-by="EVD-009"}
## Named-query graph-view regression

Evaluate a named query in the core, materialize the corresponding graph projection, and resolve it through the view manifest.
:::

::: {.need #TC-010 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="graph;cytoscape;exploration" evidenced-by="EVD-010"}
## Interactive graph exploration asset regression

Verify the shipped exploration modules, semantic traversal markers, root-path support, filters, and canonical/showcase asset parity.
:::

::: {.need #TC-011 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="baseline;diff;impact" evidenced-by="EVD-011"}
## Baseline, diff, and impact regression

Build a baseline, change the engineering model, and verify deterministic field changes, relocation, relation changes, and impact propagation.
:::

::: {.need #TC-012 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="extension;distribution;quarto" evidenced-by="EVD-012"}
## Canonical extension synchronization regression

Synchronize the canonical extension into an example project and verify that stale copied assets cannot become an independent implementation.
:::

::: {.need #TC-013 type="test-case" status="passed" tags="determinism;reproducibility;fingerprint" evidenced-by="EVD-013"}
## Deterministic output regression

Repeat analysis and rendering inputs and verify byte-stable or fingerprint-stable engineering outputs where the contract requires determinism.
:::

## Evidence

::: {.need #EVD-001 type="evidence" status="verified" tags="pytest;snapshot;analysis"}
## Analysis and export regression suite

Checked-in tests covering canonical snapshots, exports, graph semantics, and stable analysis behaviour.
:::

:::

## Rule and quality-gate test suite

Regression tests exercise structural rules, configurable governance, coverage, and gate evaluation.
:::

::: {.need #EVD-004 type="evidence" status="verified" tags="pytest;adr;decision"}

Decision relation, lifecycle, cycle, confirmation, and review-date tests demonstrate the first-class ADR model.

## Public graph schema and semantic-projection tests

Schema validation and graph semantics tests exercise bounded projection metadata and safe provenance publication.

Parser fixtures cover QMD declarations, relation forms, source locations, rationale, and declaration normalization.

Catalog tests cover authoring names, inverse forms, roles, semantic families, impact direction, and traversal semantics.

Tests verify safe query evaluation, deterministic selection, materialized graph views, and manifest lookup.

Static asset regressions assert exploration capabilities and prevent semantic relation tables from being reintroduced into presentation code.

::: {.need #EVD-011 type="evidence" status="verified" tags="pytest;baseline;impact"}
## Baseline and impact comparison suite

Checked-in baseline, diff, and impact tests demonstrate deterministic comparison semantics and path explanations.
:::

::: {.need #EVD-012 type="evidence" status="verified" tags="python;extension;sync"}
## Canonical pre-render synchronization workflow

`tools/quarto_needs_pre_render.py` installs the canonical extension into staged examples before analysis and rendering.
:::

::: {.need #EVD-013 type="evidence" status="verified" tags="pytest;determinism;fingerprint"}

Repeat-analysis tests and canonical fixtures demonstrate stable fingerprints and byte-level output where required.
